scope: Local brief-to-implementation and artifact audit. Implementation, actual engineering evidence, historical diagnostics and pending live validation are separate. Not organizer scoring, independent certification or proof of unseen-audio correctness. No inference or network transmission was performed by this audit.
remaining_required_user_artifact: demo.mp4, at most 120 seconds, recorded last after final validation and own-voice rehearsal

current_engineering.scope: Engineering and official dataset checks only; no current LLM answer or speech pass is inferred.

selected_public_inference_configuration.configuration_scope: Selected application settings; no inference score is claimed by this engineering run.
selected_public_inference_configuration.note: A successful generic connection probe is not a practice, conversation, baseline or speech evaluation. Current configured-model evaluation is not started while payload approval is pending.

current_validation_pending.scope: Exposed development regression, not a new independent holdout.

current_validation_pending.requirement: Current report and complete ZIP validation

stopped_local_diagnostic.scope: Local qwen3:4b-instruct diagnostic intentionally stopped before hosted-model switch. Eleven mechanical passes among thirteen checked are not a complete 52-question result. Five supported-with-limits, four material-error and four uncertain judgments are a separate assistant review, not an adjusted score or independent certification.

prompt_only_baseline.scope: Earlier runtime. Saved labels saying current are original historical text and are not adopted by this audit.

legacy_fallback_questions.scope: Earlier runtime. Saved labels saying current are original historical text and are not adopted by this audit.

legacy_fallback_conversations.scope: Earlier runtime. Saved labels saying current are original historical text and are not adopted by this audit.

historical_measurements.comparison_limit: Historical perfect question/conversation scores included authored fallback or rules output. They are not current source-only model results. Model/version and implementation differences confound comparisons; current same-model reruns remain pending.

requirements.finding: Any supported Gnani language is permitted; all ten are not mandatory. Primary scope is English, Hindi and Hinglish. Additional regional routes remain optional previews; configuration is not proof of language quality.

requirements.requirement: Step 1 prompt-only LLM and first-reply AI disclosure
requirements.finding: The baseline calls the LLM without company documents, catalog, private orders or Agent context. Historical baseline output is preserved. A complete baseline using the current configured provider/model has not run.

requirements.requirement: Step 2 document chunks, embeddings, vector retrieval and saved sources
requirements.finding: Section IDs and authority/status/effective-date metadata are retained. Lexical and multilingual dense retrieval preserve direct candidates plus bounded source dependencies. Actual supplied source sections and IDs are saved; they are context provenance, not per-claim semantic proof.

requirements.requirement: Grounded answers, abstention and unseen questions without hardcoded answers
requirements.finding: Normal policy text is generated from actual retrieved sources and safe source-derived or verified facts. No authored policy answer fallback is substituted after failure. Finite source-bound validation and one repair may end in uncertainty. Operational authentication/privacy/safety and reviewed tool workflows remain deterministic. Neither engineering tests nor exposed practice prove unseen-question correctness.

Historical scores are noncurrent. The old perfect RAG scores included authored fallback output and cannot be presented as current source-only generation performance. Current configured-model baseline and complete source-only question results must be measured and compared, with composition and limitations disclosed.

requirements.requirement: Step 3 session context, follow-ups, one clarification, refusal and handover
requirements.finding: A shared session retains relevant public and verified state, asks for missing inputs, and uses the supplied tools. The historical 96-turn result is not evidence for the revised runtime; the full current conversation rerun remains pending.

requirements.requirement: Caller verification and confirmed ticket creation
requirements.finding: Supplied lookup tools require proof before private details are exposed. Ticket success requires actual created=True; tool failure is retained. Engineering checks exercise these contracts, but no current complete live conversation pass is inferred.

requirements.requirement: Official dataset, string IDs, policy authority and calendar rules
requirements.finding: The official validator passed nine CSVs and 21 KB documents. IDs remain strings; reference date is 2026-10-20, business days are Mon-Sat excluding supplied holidays, and return windows use calendar days. Source precedence and successor-authorized historical scope are represented.

requirements.requirement: Gnani-only STT and TTS around the same conversation agent
requirements.finding: The REST adapter uses Gnani only, explicit timbre-v2.5 and validated reply WAVs. Batch and UI use the same stateful agent. Earlier synthetic speech successes belong to earlier runtimes and do not validate the current source-only/hosted configuration.

requirements.requirement: Short speech replies, spoken dates/IDs and unclear-audio recovery
requirements.finding: Speech formatting groups long numeric IDs and handles spoken numbers; WAV clips above the REST duration limit are rejected locally. Failure recovery attempts genuine Gnani reply audio. Current speech/recovery validation, own-voice rehearsal and subjective listening remain pending; synthetic round trips do not establish accent/noise robustness.

Streamlit recording, upload and reply playback meet the permitted interface category. A richer frontend, deployment and telephony are not mandatory. Code and engineering checks do not replace final browser/own-voice review.

requirements.requirement: README, dependencies, keyless env example and public repository
requirements.finding: Installation and the exact organizer command are documented, with a keyless environment template. The declared public repository is https://github.com/Pranay207/Resolvox. Final docs/configuration refresh, final push and verification of the public final commit remain pending; this audit makes no network/public-access claim.

requirements.requirement: One audio-folder command saves text, speech and document chunks
requirements.finding: python run.py --audio_dir <in> --out_dir <out> writes answer text, JSON, source chunks and real Gnani reply WAVs on successful speech, with per-file failures and session controls. The current final speech batch has not run.

requirements.requirement: Report at most four pages with steps, scores, failures and fixes
requirements.finding: The present PDF is a draft. Final baseline/RAG results, failures and actual model configuration must be included before rendering and visual inspection. Existing PDF QA describes an earlier runtime and cannot certify revised bytes.

requirements.requirement: Demo at most two minutes with grounded question, follow-up and handover or uncertainty
requirements.finding: demo.mp4 is absent. The user explicitly wants this last, after final validation and own-voice rehearsal. Required content and the 120-second cap remain unchanged.

requirements.requirement: Final submission ZIP layout and exclusion of secrets, environment and dataset
requirements.finding: The existing pranay_voiceops.zip is an old draft without demo.mp4 and does not represent current source bytes. Rebuild only after final deliverables are ready; verify extraction, root layout, hashes, key exclusions and current batch entry point. The team-name assumption pranay still needs final confirmation.

Complete and preserve current configured-model baseline, source-only question/conversation, requested additional live and Gnani speech/recovery checks; review actual answers and retain failures.
Refresh documentation and the at-most-four-page report from actual results and configuration; render and inspect the final PDF.
Complete own-voice/browser rehearsal and subjective listening, then record the required at-most-120-second demo last.
Build the final correctly named ZIP with all root deliverables and generated sample outputs; repeat extraction, CLI/import smoke, manifest/hash and secret/exclusion checks.
Publish the final repository revision and verify its public URL and remote commit after the demo and release evidence are included.
